dedupe_keys.name: otsun solar collector ray tracing model

description: OTSun is a Python optical model for solar-thermal collectors and photovoltaic cells with arbitrary geometry. Its README describes Monte Carlo forward ray tracing, pip installation, a FreeCAD dependency and a published method paper. Users define a collector or cell geometry and incident light conditions; outputs are optical paths and absorbed-energy estimates for that device. Geographic coverage is not fixed because the model examines component optics; local solar resource must be supplied separately. GitHub metadata states MIT licensing. A limitation is that optical absorption does not establish complete field energy yield, thermal losses, inverter behaviour or degradation. FreeCAD geometry and material properties must also be checked. OTSun can help parameterise collector performance for solar heat or electricity infrastructure simulation. The related ERA5 catalogue record supplies weather context, not device optics. No CAD models, executable package or weather data were downloaded.
inputs: Collector geometry, materials and incident radiation
name: OTSun solar collector ray-tracing model
